This is my private collection of lab protocols.  
Most of them are from by time as a postdoc at the Goldrath Lab

::: {.callout-note}
All protocols without warranty. 
:::

## Sections

I have tried to organize the protocols in different sections. Sometimes an assignment is not clearly possible. If looking for a protocol, the search function in the top left corner is very useful.

### [{{< fa disease >}} T cells](/protocols/t_cells)

This sections contains protocols that mainly deal with T cells (e.g. CD8 selection,  CD3/CD28 T cell activation)


### [{{< fa virus >}} Infections](/protocols/infections)

Here you'll find protocol for LCMV and Listeria infection as well as protocols to make retrovirus.

### [{{< fa dragon >}} Mice](/protocols/mice)

Everything you need to know  about lymphocyte isolation from mouse tissues.

### [{{< fa flask >}} Molecular Biology](/protocols/mol_bio)

Classic protocols for RNA Isolation, cDNA Synthesis, PCRs and Western

### [{{< fa laptop-code >}} Bioinformatics](/protocols/bioinformatics)

What's there to say? The name is self-explanatory. This sections is also known as dry lab.

### [{{< fa blender >}} Recipes](/protocols/recipes)

Potions tutorial and cell media recipes.

### [{{< fa address-card >}} Organizational](/protocols/orga)

How do I book flow time? How do I sort? Where can I find a database of all antibodies.

### [{{< fa donate >}} Contribute](/protocols/contribute)

Get involved and learn how to add protocols or correct mistakes. This section also includes a list of shortcodes.
